color.note: Two themes. Light is primary: neutral light-grey page, white cards, red accents. Dark: near-black surfaces, red accents. The brand gradient is 135deg grad-start → grad-mid 45% → grad-end; buttons use grad-mid → grad-end.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards (soft neutral grey in light, near-black in dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, header, modals.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: inputs, table header, secondary rows inside a card.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, icon wells, soft badges, hover on ghost items.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on surface.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, dashed add-tiles, control outlines (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings and key numbers on surface/bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on surface/bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta (≥4.5:1 on surface and bg).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Gooseroot Red: links, active nav, icons, focus, progress fill, primary text accents.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of primary text and links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills and the brand gradient.

tokens.name: grad-start
tokens.usage: Scarlet: start of the brand gradient (hero surfaces, sidebar rail, promo cards). Large/bold white text only.

tokens.name: grad-mid
tokens.usage: Mid stop of the brand gradient; start of the button gradient.

tokens.name: grad-end
tokens.usage: Crimson: end of every brand gradient.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Deep Wine: strong neutral fill (dark buttons, tooltips, toasts). Replaces black.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ink fills.

tokens.name: footer-bg
tokens.usage: Website footer background (Deep Wine). Text on it uses on-footer.

tokens.name: on-footer
tokens.usage: Text and links on footer-bg.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed state, success toasts, positive deltas. The only green; never decorative.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background for success badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (form errors, delete).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background for error alerts and invalid inputs.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and drawers (neutral black).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page greeting / page title in apps.

tokens.usage: Inputs, icon buttons, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menu items, list rows.
